capabilities.name: PARA + Zettelkasten authority routing
capabilities.must_test: New evidence must be captured without confusing operational PARA location with durable linked-note authority

capabilities.name: LLM Wiki ingest
capabilities.must_test: Integrate new source with provenance, update existing synthesis when appropriate, avoid duplicate canonical knowledge

capabilities.name: LLM Wiki query routing
capabilities.must_test: Find answer through maintained knowledge with source traceability and minimal irrelevant reads

capabilities.name: ICM + LLM Wiki composition
capabilities.must_test: Native ICM workflow consumes maintained synthesis without merging schemas or copying authority

capabilities.name: Human vs agent knowledge authority
capabilities.must_test: Resolve same topic across human Zettelkasten and agent-maintained wiki without silently overwriting either

capabilities.name: Profile-aware linting
capabilities.must_test: Hybrid fixture contains one ICM defect, one wiki issue, and one valid method overlay; classify each at correct scope

capabilities.name: Nested authority routing
capabilities.must_test: Outer PARA/CCA project contains native ICM subtree and LLM Wiki; operate without flattening boundaries

capabilities.name: Cross-scope method composition
capabilities.must_test: Scrum + XP + DevOps + Lean coexist at different scopes without invented hybrid methodology

capabilities.name: Same-scope method conflict
capabilities.must_test: Scrum vs Kanban or SAFe vs LeSS requires explicit tradeoff/conflict rather than fake merge

capabilities.name: Methodology non-trigger
capabilities.must_test: Ordinary implementation task must not load advisor/framework corpus without workspace evidence

capabilities.name: Hybrid lifecycle routing
capabilities.must_test: Evidence moves through capture/distill/maintained synthesis/use while each human/agent method keeps its own authority

capabilities.name: Portable agent guidance
capabilities.must_test: Add cross-agent guidance without replacing native harness/profile instruction authority

capabilities.name: Generic workspace builder
capabilities.must_test: Build useful non-ICM workspace from actual workflow without imposing staged ICM structure

capabilities.name: System Map change impact
capabilities.must_test: Map live/leftover/ghost code and blast radius from source evidence without duplicating source tree

capabilities.name: Context Map operational model
capabilities.must_test: Represent organizational/process/information relationships without confusing them with source-code impact

capabilities.name: Record Library schema preservation
capabilities.must_test: Create/update record using local template, explicit identifier/catalog authority, and half-created detection

capabilities.name: Cross-profile restructure
capabilities.must_test: Migration proposal preserves nested authorities and requires approval before destructive changes

capabilities.name: Knowledge contradiction handling
capabilities.must_test: Source conflict is preserved with provenance rather than silently resolved into false certainty

capabilities.name: Advisor escalation boundary
capabilities.must_test: Architecture consults only needed advisor domain and escalates hard-stop uncertainty without folding advisor into structural authority

capabilities.name: Progressive-disclosure efficiency
capabilities.must_test: Compare references/files/tokens loaded on simple, native ICM, and hybrid tasks; broader CCA scope must not impose unnecessary context tax
